title: Add automated testing infrastructure and CI/CD workflows
body:
## Optimization Plan: Automated Testing and Basic Workflows ✅

### Phase 1: Testing Infrastructure ✅
- [x] Install and configure Vitest as the test framework
- [x] Add testing utilities and setup files
- [x] Configure test scripts in root and package-level package.json files

### Phase 2: Write Tests for Core Packages ✅
- [x] Add tests for @object-ui/protocol package (6 tests)
- [x] Add tests for @object-ui/engine package (3 tests)
- [x] Add tests for @object-ui/renderer package (12 tests)
- [x] Add tests for @object-ui/ui package (7 tests)
- [x] Add tests for @object-ui/designer package (2 tests)
- [x] **Total: 36 tests passing** ✅

### Phase 3: GitHub Actions Workflows ✅
- [x] Create CI workflow for testing and linting (multi-node testing on Node 18.x & 20.x)
- [x] Create build workflow to verify all packages build correctly
- [x] Create release workflow for publishing packages
- [x] Create PR checks workflow for automated PR validation
- [x] Fix pnpm version compatibility (updated to pnpm 10)

### Phase 4: Additional Improvements ✅
- [x] Add test coverage reporting with @vitest/coverage-v8
- [x] Update README with testing instructions and CI badges
- [x] Add CONTRIBUTING.md with development guidelines
- [x] Add CHANGELOG.md for tracking project changes
- [x] Add TESTING.md with comprehensive testing documentation
- [x] Update all package.json files with proper test scripts
- [x] Configure TypeScript to exclude test files from compilation
- [x] Fix missing vi imports in test files
- [x] Update release workflow to use non-deprecated action
- [x] Improve button test to use userEvent for realistic interactions
- [x] Fix CI lockfile compatibility issue

## 🎉 Summary

All objectives completed successfully! The project now has:
- ✅ Comprehensive test suite with 36 passing tests
- ✅ Automated CI/CD workflows (3 workflow files) with correct pnpm version
- ✅ Test coverage reporting
- ✅ Complete documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, TESTING)
- ✅ Proper package configuration across all workspaces
- ✅ All code review feedback addressed
- ✅ CI lockfile compatibility issue resolved
